title: Overprint
description: Three huge numerals in process red, blue and yellow race up a shallow diagonal across paper-white stock, each a translucent ink laid over the others. Where they cross the inks multiply like a real press run: red over yellow goes vermilion, blue over yellow goes green, all three go nearly black. At speed a numeral prints its pace the way Huber did, as flat hard-edged bands of its own ink trailing behind it. Pick one up and its plate lifts off the paper and casts a shadow; throw it and it drops back into register on the nearest line, running at the pace you gave it.
intent: After Max Huber's Monza race posters (Gran Premio dell'Autodromo 1948, 500 Miglia di Monza 1957), where transparent primary inks overprint so numbers and speed bands mix into new colours as they cross. https://a-g-i.org/design/500-miglia-di-monza
